# GitRemind — Full Architectural and Technical Reference for AI Coding Agents

> Comprehensive developer guide, internal module documentation, type definitions, and integration mechanics for AI agents working with or synthesizing code for GitRemind.

---

## 1. System Overview & Core Purpose

GitRemind is an automated developer productivity daemon and CLI tool written in TypeScript. It tracks Git repositories on the local filesystem, computes clean/dirty working tree states via high-speed porcelain parsing, and dispatches native desktop notifications when:
1. **Interval Exceeded**: Uncommitted changes have remained idle past the configured cadence (default: 20 minutes).
2. **Project Closed**: An IDE or editor process launched via `gitremind open <editor> <path>` terminates while uncommitted changes exist.
3. **Terminal Exited**: A terminal shell session exits while dirty files remain (via PowerShell/Bash/Zsh hooks).
4. **Interactive Dashboard**: A developer accesses real-time repository health via a Claude CLI-style terminal dashboard (`npx gitremind` or `gitremind dashboard`).
5. **Commit Assistance**: A developer invokes the Conventional Commit wizard (`gitremind commit`) to stage and commit changes adhering to the Conventional Commits 1.0.0 specification.

---

## 2. Architecture & Event Flow

```
                      ┌──────────────────────────┐
                      │   File System Mutation   │
                      └─────────────┬────────────┘
                                    │
                                    ▼
                      ┌──────────────────────────┐
                      │    Chokidar FSWatcher    │
                      └─────────────┬────────────┘
                                    │ (Event: add, change, unlink)
                                    ▼
                      ┌──────────────────────────┐
                      │  2500ms Debounce Buffer  │
                      └─────────────┬────────────┘
                                    │
                                    ▼
                      ┌──────────────────────────┐
                      │   git status --porcelain │
                      └─────────────┬────────────┘
                                    │
                                    ▼
                      ┌──────────────────────────┐
                      │  parsePorcelainLine()    │
                      │  GitRepoState Evaluator  │
                      └─────────────┬────────────┘
                                    │
                    ┌───────────────┴───────────────┐
                    │                               │
            [State Changed: Dirty]          [State Changed: Clean]
                    │                               │
                    ▼                               ▼
       ┌────────────────────────┐       ┌────────────────────────┐
       │ Set firstDirtyAt       │       │ Clear firstDirtyAt     │
       │ Update config metadata │       │ Clear lastNotifiedAt   │
       └────────────┬───────────┘       └────────────────────────┘
                    │
                    ▼
       ┌────────────────────────┐
       │ 60s Interval Timer     │
       │ Check (Now - Baseline) │
       │      >= Interval?      │
       └────────────┬───────────┘
                    │
            ┌───────┴───────┐
           YES              NO
            │                │
            ▼                ▼
   ┌─────────────────┐   [Wait for Next Tick]
   │ Quiet Hours?    │
   └────────┬────────┘
       ┌────┴────┐
       NO       YES
       │         │
       ▼         ▼
┌──────────────┐ ┌───────────────┐
│ Send Desktop │ │ Suppress Alert│
│ Notification │ └───────────────┘
└──────────────┘
```

---

## 3. Complete TypeScript Type Definitions (`src/core/types.ts`)

```typescript
export type FileChangeKind =
  | 'modified'
  | 'staged'
  | 'untracked'
  | 'deleted'
  | 'renamed'
  | 'conflicted';

export interface GitFileStatus {
  path: string;
  kind: FileChangeKind;
  staged: boolean;
  rawStatus: string;
}

export interface GitRepoSummary {
  modified: number;
  untracked: number;
  staged: number;
  deleted: number;
  total: number;
}

export interface GitRepoState {
  isGitRepo: boolean;
  rootPath: string;
  name: string;
  branch: string;
  isDirty: boolean;
  files: GitFileStatus[];
  summary: GitRepoSummary;
  lastCommitTime: Date | null;
  lastCommitRelative: string;
  lastCommitHash: string;
  lastCommitMessage: string;
  firstDirtyTime?: Date | null;
  firstDirtyRelative?: string;
  error?: string;
}

export interface CommitOptions {
  files?: string[];
  message: string;
  repoPath?: string;
}

export interface CommitResult {
  success: boolean;
  hash?: string;
  message?: string;
  commitHash?: string;
  commitMessage?: string;
  filesCommitted?: number;
  relativeTime?: string;
  error?: string;
}

export interface WatchedRepoConfig {
  path: string;
  name: string;
  addedAt: string;
  lastNotifiedAt?: string;
  lastSeenDirtyAt?: string;
  lastFileCount?: number;
}

export interface QuietHoursConfig {
  enabled: boolean;
  start: string; // "HH:MM" 24h format, e.g. "23:00"
  end: string;   // "HH:MM" 24h format, e.g. "08:00"
}

export interface GitRemindConfig {
  version: number;
  intervalMinutes: number;
  notifyOnClose: boolean;
  sound: boolean;
  language: 'en' | 'tr';
  watchedRepos: WatchedRepoConfig[];
  ignorePatterns: string[];
  ideProcesses: string[];
  quietHours: QuietHoursConfig;
}

export type NotificationTrigger = 'interval' | 'close' | 'idle' | 'manual' | 'test';

export interface NotificationPayload {
  trigger: NotificationTrigger;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  message: string;
  repoName?: string;
  repoPath?: string;
  branch?: string;
  fileCount?: number;
  filesPreview?: string[];
}

export interface DaemonStatus {
  running: boolean;
  pid?: number;
  startedAt?: string;
  uptimeSeconds?: number;
  watchedCount: number;
  dirtyCount: number;
}
```

---

## 4. Module-by-Module Internal Reference

### `src/core/git.ts` — Git Engine & Porcelain Parsing
Executes non-blocking Git commands via `child_process.execFile` with 8000ms timeout and `windowsHide: true`.
- `runGit(args: string[], cwd: string): Promise<string>`: Low-level child process wrapper.
- `isGitRepository(dir: string): Promise<boolean>`: Executes `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree`.
- `getRepoRoot(dir: string): Promise<string | null>`: Executes `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`.
- `parsePorcelainLine(line: string): GitFileStatus | null`:
  - Parses 2-character XY status codes from `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall`.
  - `??` -> untracked (`kind: untracked`, `staged: false`).
  - ` M` -> modified unstaged (`kind: modified`, `staged: false`).
  - `M ` -> modified staged (`kind: staged`, `staged: true`).
  - `A ` -> added staged (`kind: staged`, `staged: true`).
  - ` D` / `D ` -> deleted (`kind: deleted`).
  - `R ` -> renamed (`kind: renamed`, handles `old -> new` path resolution).
  - `UU`, `AA`, `DD` -> merge conflict (`kind: conflicted`).
- `getRepoState(repoPath: string): Promise<GitRepoState>`:
  - Resolves branch via `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`.
  - Parses dirty file list and computes `GitRepoSummary`.
  - Extracts last commit hash, relative time, and message via `git log -1 --format=%H|%cr|%ct|%s`.
- `stageAll(repoPath: string): Promise<string>`: Runs `git add -A`.
- `stageFiles(repoPath: string, files: string[]): Promise<string>`: Runs `git add -- <files...>`.
- `commitChanges(options: CommitOptions): Promise<CommitResult>`: Commits changes, parses output hash, and verifies clean tree.
- `formatTimeAgo(date: Date): string`: Formats human-readable relative time string.

### `src/core/watcher.ts` — Real-Time FSWatcher & Timing Engine
- `RepoWatcher` class:
  - Instantiates `chokidar.watch()` with configured ignore patterns (`**/node_modules/**`, `**/.git/**`, `**/dist/**`, etc.).
  - Configures `awaitWriteFinish` with 1000ms stability threshold and 200ms poll interval.
  - Implements `queueEvaluation()` with a 2500ms debounce timer to coalesce file system burst events.
  - Runs a 60-second periodic timer checking:
    ```typescript
    const baseline = this.lastNotifiedAt?.getTime() ?? this.firstDirtyAt?.getTime();
    if (Date.now() - baseline >= intervalMs) {
      // dispatch notification & update lastNotifiedAt
    }
    ```
  - Emits clean state transitions when working tree becomes clean, clearing `firstDirtyAt` and `lastNotifiedAt`.

### `src/core/daemon.ts` — Background Process Supervisor
- `GitRemindDaemon` class:
  - `static isRunning(): { running: boolean; pid?: number }`: Checks existence of PID file at `~/.gitremind/gitremind.pid` and verifies process vitality using `process.kill(pid, 0)`.
  - `static spawnBackground(entryPath: string)`:
    - Spawns detached Node process: `spawn(process.execPath, [entryPath, 'daemon', 'run'], { detached: true, stdio: ['ignore', fd, fd], windowsHide: true })`.
    - Unrefs child process handle allowing parent process to terminate cleanly.
  - `start(): Promise<void>`:
    - Writes PID to `gitremind.pid`.
    - Registers signal listeners (`SIGINT`, `SIGTERM`, `exit`) for atomic PID cleanup.
    - Synchronizes repository watchers via `syncWatchers()` every 10 seconds.
  - `syncWatchers()`: Reconciles active `RepoWatcher` instances against configured `watchedRepos` dynamically without restarting daemon.

### `src/core/notifier.ts` — Native Cross-Platform Notifications
- `Notifier` class:
  - Windows: Executes `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/win-toast.ps1 -Title ... -Subtitle ... -Message ... [-Sound]` using the native WinRT `Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification` XML API.
  - macOS: Executes AppleScript via `osascript -e 'display notification ...'`.
  - Linux: Executes `notify-send`.
  - `isQuietHour(config: GitRemindConfig): boolean`: Evaluates whether current system time falls between `config.quietHours.start` and `config.quietHours.end` (supporting overnight midnight crossing, e.g. 23:00 to 08:00).
  - `formatMessage(payload, config)`: Formats localized titles, headers, and previews in English or Turkish.

### `src/core/process-tracker.ts` — IDE & Process Exit Detection
- `ProcessTracker` class:
  - `isProcessAlive(pid: number): boolean`: Polls process survival via `process.kill(pid, 0)`.
  - `runSession(editorCommand: string, args: string[], repoPath: string): Promise<number>`:
    - Spawns editor child process with inherited stdio (`spawn(editorCommand, args, { cwd: repoPath, stdio: 'inherit', shell: true })`).
    - When child exits, immediately evaluates `getRepoState(repoPath)`.
    - If `state.isDirty === true`, triggers `trigger: 'close'` desktop notification and displays console alert banner.

### `src/cli/tui.ts` — Retro ANSI Terminal UI Library
- `renderBox(options)`: Renders Unicode rounded-corner boxes (`╭─`, `─╮`, `│`, `╰─`, `─╯`) with ANSI-safe width calculation.
- `pad(str, targetWidth, align)`: Pads strings respecting ANSI formatting escape codes.
- `stripAnsi(str)`: Removes ANSI control codes for exact visual length measurement.
- `formatBadge(kind)`: Returns color-coded status badges: `[M]` (yellow), `[A]` (cyan), `[?]` (green), `[D]` (red), `[!]` (bgRed).
- `formatDaemonPill(running, pid)`: Returns `🟢 Active [PID: x]` or `🔴 Stopped`.
- `formatStatusPill(isDirty, count)`: Returns `🟡 Dirty (x uncommitted files)` or `🟢 Clean`.
- `renderActionBar(actions)`: Formats keyboard hotkey navigation strip.

### `src/cli/commit-wizard.ts` — Conventional Commit Wizard
- `runCommitWizard(targetPath?: string)`:
  - Inspects dirty files and presents categorized preview.
  - Prompts for commit type:
    1. `feat`: New feature
    2. `fix`: Bug fix
    3. `docs`: Documentation
    4. `refactor`: Refactoring
    5. `perf`: Performance
    6. `test`: Tests
    7. `chore`: Tooling/maintenance
    8. `custom`: Custom prefix
  - Prompts for optional scope (e.g. `auth`, `ui`, `core`).
  - Prompts for commit subject message.
  - Shows preview box: `type(scope): message`.
  - Confirms and invokes `commitChanges()` with automatic staging.

### `src/cli/dashboard.ts` — Interactive TUI Loop (`DashboardApp`)
- Full interactive terminal dashboard application.
- Sets `process.stdin.setRawMode(true)` to capture single keystrokes without Enter:
  - `↑` / `↓` / `k` / `j`: Navigate watched repository list.
  - `c`: Launch Conventional Commit wizard.
  - `w`: Add current directory to watch list.
  - `u`: Remove selected repository from watch list.
  - `s`: Toggle daemon process (start/stop).
  - `n`: Fire test notification.
  - `r`: Force instant git refresh.
  - `q` / `Ctrl+C`: Gracefully exit dashboard.
- Auto-refreshes every 4 seconds. Non-TTY environments exit cleanly after printing a snapshot.

---

## 5. Storage & File Locations

- **Configuration File**:
  - Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.gitremind\config.json`
  - macOS/Linux: `~/.gitremind/config.json`
- **PID File**:
  - Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.gitremind\gitremind.pid`
  - macOS/Linux: `~/.gitremind/gitremind.pid`
- **Daemon Log File**:
  - Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.gitremind\daemon.log`
  - macOS/Linux: `~/.gitremind/daemon.log`

---

## 6. Programmatic TypeScript API Usage

```typescript
import {
  getRepoState,
  isGitRepository,
  stageAll,
  commitChanges,
  GitRemindDaemon,
  RepoWatcher,
  notifier,
  configManager
} from 'gitremind';

// 1. Inspect repository state
const state = await getRepoState('./my-project');
console.log(`Repository: ${state.name} (${state.branch})`);
console.log(`Dirty: ${state.isDirty}, Files: ${state.summary.total}`);

for (const file of state.files) {
  console.log(` ${file.kind.toUpperCase()} - ${file.path} (staged: ${file.staged})`);
}

// 2. Add repo to configuration
await configManager.addRepo('./my-project');

// 3. Start background watcher programmatically
const config = configManager.load();
const watcher = new RepoWatcher('./my-project', config);
await watcher.start();

// 4. Dispatch custom notification
await notifier.notify({
  trigger: 'interval',
  title: 'Git Snapshot Reminder',
  message: 'You have uncommitted modifications in payment-service.',
  repoName: 'payment-service',
  branch: 'main',
  fileCount: 3,
  filesPreview: ['server.ts', 'routes.ts']
});

// 5. Stage and commit changes
const result = await commitChanges({
  repoPath: './my-project',
  message: 'feat(api): add stripe billing webhook'
});
console.log(`Committed: ${result.commitHash}`);
```

---

## 7. Shell Exit Integration Mechanics

### PowerShell Engine Event
Registers for the `PowerShell.Exiting` engine event. Executes inside the exiting session before socket tear down:
```powershell
Register-EngineEvent PowerShell.Exiting -Action {
    try {
        if (git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>$null) {
            $dirty = git status --porcelain=v1 2>$null
            if ($dirty) {
                Write-Host "`n[GitRemind] ⚠️  WARNING: Uncommitted changes detected before terminal exit!" -ForegroundColor Yellow
                git status -s
                gitremind check 2>$null
            }
        }
    } catch {}
} | Out-Null
```

### POSIX Shells (Bash & Zsh)
Leverages the POSIX `trap <handler> EXIT` signal:
```bash
gitremind_exit_hook() {
    if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain=v1 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            printf "\n\033[1;33m[GitRemind] ⚠️  WARNING: Uncommitted changes detected before exit!\033[0m\n"
            git status -s
            gitremind check >/dev/null 2>&1 &
        fi
    fi
}
trap gitremind_exit_hook EXIT
```
